integrity: Closed-form proof for the stated two-state active extrapolation; independent validation has not been performed; all numerical checks are supplemental to the proof.
limitations: Does not cover passive extrapolation, three or more states, time-varying generators or steps, nonlinear positivity corrections, or independent publication-priority certification.
title: Reentrant probability loss and exact parity recovery for Richardson-extrapolated backward Euler on two-state chains
